revision: Kusanagi and Muramasa v4 from the user's illustrations, 2026-10-30
generation_mode: Cut out of the user-supplied illustrations (art.zip: Kusanagi.png, Muramasa Transformed.png); no image generation.
source_scope: The recovered shared conversation establishes Divinity/Kusanagi and Cursed/Muramasa skill themes. The private Discord message and deeper project backstory were not readable; no additional canon is claimed.
visual_references: User supplied gold/blue Kusanagi and red/black Muramasa illustrations; matching originals are Kusanagi.png and Muramasa Transformed.png in art.zip.

validation.strict_spr_act_validation: Passed for both variants and floor sprites (compile_weapons.py). Equipped pairs retain 104 actions and 304 frames.
validation.pose_metadata: Attack and ready poses unchanged (weapon_pose_audit.json); the v4 sources keep the convention of tip right, cutting edge below.
validation.runtime_gui_checks: 8 offline captures at prt_fild08, 2000x1125, distance 300 (no server, no login): ready facing S and W, attack at 180 ms facing S and at 270 ms facing E, for each weapon. Hilts sit in the hands and the cutting edge leads.
validation.visual_limits: The body holds one katana in stacked fists, so the off-hand hilt sits beside the main grip. Muramasa's tassel is a few pixels at game scale.
validation.gameplay_scope: This revision changes weapon artwork only. Item scripts and stats are unchanged.
validation.dual_wield: Offline captures at prt_fild08, 2000x1125, distance 300, Kusanagi right and Muramasa left: ready S, attack frame 4 facing S, E and NE, frame 3 facing W and N. Live login as Hayate (Kusanagi right, Muramasa left equipped on the server): the client resolved the left hand as item 900002 and loaded muramasa_offhand; a capture while attacking shows both blades in the ready stance.

historical_sources: Unversioned, v2 and v3 kusanagi/muramasa PNGs and prompts are retained as historical reference only; the selected manifest uses v4.
runtime_changes: Both weapons now come from the user's illustrations: each sword was cut out of its background, laid flat with the cutting edge below, scaled so pommel to tip is 58 game pixels, thickened in height (Kusanagi x1.45, Muramasa x1.35) so the slender painted blades read at game size, and given a warm dark rim. Muramasa keeps its tassel past the pommel. The item description pictures are the cut-out illustrations; icons and floor sprites come from the game-size sprites.
